meaning:
γενεαλογέω, -ῶ
(γενεά, λέγω), [in LXX: 1Ch.5:1 (יחשׁ)* ;]
to trace ancestry, reckon genealogy; pass., before ἐκ: Heb.7:6.†
(AS)
glosses: who did not trace his descent

renderings.bsb: who did not trace his descent

elsewhere.note: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
